name: zz-admin-dupe-repair
description: Reload carol's roster with an injected 5x DUNK MASTER dupe, verify the red xN badge, then Scan and Repair through the admin UI

steps.expression: (() => { const c = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b => b.textContent.trim() === 'u/carol'); if (!c) return 'ERR: no carol chip'; c.click(); return 'reloaded carol'; })()
steps.name: reload carol

steps.expression: (() => { const rows = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('td[colspan="8"]')).map(td => td.innerText.trim()); const red = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('td[colspan="8"] span')).filter(s => /rgb\(255, 144, 144\)/.test(getComputedStyle(s).color)).map(s => s.innerText.trim()); return JSON.stringify({ rows, redBadges: red }); })()
steps.name: ability rows + red dupe badges

steps.expression: (() => { const el = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('td[colspan="8"]')).find(td => /DUNK MASTER/.test(td.innerText)); if (el) el.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' }); return el ? el.innerText.trim() : 'not found'; })()
steps.name: scroll to dupe row

steps.expression: (() => { const b = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(x => x.textContent.trim() === 'Scan Roster'); if (!b) return 'ERR: no Scan button'; b.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' }); b.click(); return 'clicked Scan'; })()
steps.name: click Scan Roster

steps.expression: (() => { const t = document.body.innerText; const i = t.indexOf('DRY RUN'); return i < 0 ? 'ERR: no DRY RUN report: ' + t.slice(0, 200) : t.slice(i, i + 260); })()
steps.name: dry run report

steps.expression: (() => { const b = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(x => x.textContent.trim() === 'Repair Roster'); if (!b) return 'ERR: no Repair button'; b.click(); return 'clicked Repair (arming confirm)'; })()
steps.name: arm repair

steps.expression: (() => { const b = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(x => x.textContent.trim() === 'CONFIRM REPAIR'); if (!b) return 'ERR: no CONFIRM REPAIR button'; b.click(); return 'clicked CONFIRM REPAIR'; })()
steps.name: confirm repair

steps.expression: (() => { const t = document.body.innerText; const i = t.indexOf('APPLIED'); const rows = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('td[colspan="8"]')).map(td => td.innerText.trim()); return JSON.stringify({ report: i < 0 ? null : t.slice(i, i + 220), rows }); })()
steps.name: applied report + post-repair rows
